claims.claim: Added versioned controlled-offline admission using existing Human authentication, exact first-party selection and active RUN bindings. Production opt-in remains NOT_ACTIVATED.
Implemented exact published defaults, independently authenticated per-field overrides, merged-limit validation, and rejection of overlapping, malformed, stale or inapplicable authority.

Frozen admission records retain limits and provenance; continuing work checks original owner, lease, invocation, profile, timing and source currentness, with sticky STOP and no restart reconstruction.
Checkpoint, feedback and terminal accounting reuse the existing Runtime mutation fence, with attributable reservations, monotonic cost facts, replay reconciliation and interrupted-effect blocking.
Null token limits require no usage estimate; finite token caps STOP because complete authenticated cumulative usage is not established.

REPAIR and REMEDIATION authenticate independent predecessor and authorization sources. Their unsupported native continuity explicitly blocks before adapter construction; DIRECT_CANDIDATE admission rejects.
Unopted APIs delegate to existing execution paths. Cold codec sources and the shared Git decision guard and unresolved-failure handoff implementations and tests remain unchanged.

Added focused real-Git/native regression definitions for overrides, thresholds, consent, source spoofing, replay, concurrency, interruption and withdrawal, and documented existing guard/handoff checks for Runtime.
The committed change modifies exactly the ten authorized paths and introduces no production activation, roadmap mutation or additional execution owner.
